name: Citi® / AAdvantage® Executive World Legend Mastercard®

localized_names.en: Citi® / AAdvantage® Executive World Legend Mastercard®

apr.notes: The variable APR for purchases and balance transfers is 19.74% – 29.74%, based on your creditworthiness. The variable APR for cash advances is 29.99%. The variable Penalty APR is up to 29.99%. Minimum interest charge – $0.50. Cash advance fee – either $10 or 5% of the amount of each cash advance, whichever is greater. Balance transfer fee – either $5 or 5% of the amount of each transfer, whichever is greater. The annual fee for Authorized Users is $175 for up to 3 Authorized Users and $175 for each Authorized User thereafter.

base_rate.description: Earn 1 AAdvantage® mile for every $1 spent on all other purchases

rewards.redemption_notes: Earn 1 Loyalty Point for every 1 eligible AAdvantage® mile earned from purchases to reach AAdvantage® status faster. After $150,000 in purchases in a calendar year, earn a total of 5 AAdvantage miles per $1 on eligible American Airlines purchases for the remainder of that year.

signup_bonus.description: Earn 125,000 AAdvantage bonus miles after $15,000 in purchases within the first 5 months of account opening. This page-specific limited-time offer may vary elsewhere. Not available after a new-account bonus for an Executive account in the past 48 months, or after conversion of another Citi account on which a new-account bonus was earned in the last 48 months into an Executive account.

benefits.title: Complimentary Admirals Club® membership
benefits.description: Primary cardmembers and up to two guests or immediate family members can enjoy unlimited visits to more than 100 Admirals Club and partner lounges worldwide; membership value up to $1,400.

benefits.title: Up to 40,000 additional Loyalty Points
benefits.description: Earn a 10,000 Loyalty Point bonus after reaching each of 50,000, 90,000, 165,000 and 240,000 Loyalty Points in the same status qualification year.

benefits.title: Global Entry® or TSA PreCheck® application fee credit
benefits.description: You're eligible to receive a statement credit (up to $120 every 4 years) as reimbursement for your Global Entry® or TSA PreCheck® application fee.

benefits.title: Enhanced airport experience
benefits.description: Priority check-in, airport screening where available, and priority boarding when flying American Airlines for you and up to eight companions on the same reservation.

benefits.title: First checked bag free
benefits.description: Your first checked bag is free on domestic American Airlines itineraries for you and up to eight companions traveling with you on the same reservation, a savings of up to $900 per round trip.

benefits.title: Up to $100 back on inflight and eligible Admirals Club purchases
benefits.description: Every calendar year, earn up to $100 in statement credits on inflight and eligible Admirals Club purchases when you use your card.

benefits.title: No foreign transaction fees
benefits.description: Shop like a local wherever you go with your Citi® / AAdvantage® Executive® credit card.

benefits.title: Travel protection benefits
benefits.description: Help protect your next trip with Trip Cancellation & Interruption Protection, Trip Delay Protection, Lost Baggage Protection and Worldwide Car Rental Insurance Coverage.

benefits.title: Up to $120 back on Eligible Prepaid Avis® and Budget Car Rentals
benefits.description: Earn up to $120 in statement credits every calendar year when eligible prepaid car rentals are booked directly on avis.com or budget.com.

benefits.title: Up to $180 in Lyft credits
benefits.description: After three eligible rides in a calendar month, earn a $15 Lyft credit, for up to $180 in Lyft credits annually.

benefits.title: Up to $500 back on eligible American Airlines Vacations purchases
benefits.description: Every calendar year, earn up to $250 in statement credits January through June and up to $250 July through December on eligible American Airlines Vacations travel packages or experiences.

benefits.title: Omni Champion Status and Free Night Award
benefits.description: Primary cardmembers are eligible to enroll in Omni Hotels and Resorts Champion Status. Once per calendar year, earn an Omni Free Night Award after a qualifying stay of two or more consecutive nights booked directly through Omni Hotels and Resorts on omnihotels.com. Enrollment in Champion Status is required.

benefits.title: Complimentary Avis President's Club status
benefits.description: Primary cardmembers are eligible to enroll in complimentary Avis President's Club status through August 31, 2028 via the AAdvantage Rewards page in their AAdvantage account.

lounge_access.notes: Complimentary Admirals Club membership for the primary cardmember with up to two guests or immediate family members; membership value up to $1,400.

travel_perks.free_checked_bags: First checked bag free on domestic American Airlines itineraries for you and up to 8 companions (savings up to $900 per round trip)
travel_perks.hotel_status: Omni Hotels and Resorts Champion Status for primary cardmembers; enrollment required.
other: Priority check-in, airport screening where available, and priority boarding on American Airlines for you and up to eight companions on the same reservation
Up to $100 in statement credits per calendar year for inflight and eligible Admirals Club purchases
Travel protection: Trip Cancellation & Interruption, Trip Delay, Lost Baggage, Worldwide Car Rental Insurance
Up to $120 back on eligible prepaid Avis and Budget car rentals per calendar year
Up to $180 in Lyft credits annually: $15 after three eligible rides per calendar month
Up to $500 in eligible American Airlines Vacations credits per calendar year, split into two $250 half-year limits
Omni Free Night Award once per calendar year after a qualifying two-or-more-night direct stay; Champion Status enrollment required

notes: Verified against the official American Airlines Executive product page and Citi World Legend product page on 2026-10-19. Pricing and the page-specific 125,000-mile offer are from the AA page; Citi corroborates World Legend identity, 12x hotels/cars, elevated AA earning after $150,000 spend, and current benefits. No exact historical upgrade/conversion date is established. The former 25% inflight savings and Grubhub credit are not represented as current benefits; current official pages instead list the $100 inflight/Admirals Club credit. Matching clean card artwork is served by the official AA product page; copyright remains Citi.
